USR.TraumaGlancingBlow: Glancing Blow: Shaken. No additional mechanical penalties.
USR.TraumaFalteringPain: Faltering Pain: Must pass a Willpower check (Normal, 4 dice) or drop to the Worst position on the combat monitor.
USR.TraumaFleshWound: Flesh Wound: The injury cuts deep into soft tissue but misses vitals.
USR.TraumaGrizzledScar: Grizzled Scar: Bleeds heavily. The character gains a prominent, permanent narrative scar across the impacted hit location.
USR.TraumaBluntTrauma: Blunt Trauma: The blow cracks skeletal structures or severely bruises internal systems. Drop prone and lose your next main action.
USR.TraumaBoneFracture: Bone Fracture: A bone is cracked, shattered, or dislocated. The character suffers a permanent minor impairment to a skill.
USR.TraumaArterialGash: Arterial Gash: A major blood vessel is severed. The character immediately falls prone from sudden fluid loss.
USR.TraumaTraumaticKnockout: Traumatic Knockout: The character is instantly knocked unconscious. They may attempt a Willpower check (Hard, 2 dice) at the start of each round to wake up.
USR.TraumaSevereNerveInjury: Severe Nerve Injury: Brutal trauma to the skull, spine, or nervous system. The character falls unconscious and permanently loses 1 point from a mental or sensory attribute.
USR.TraumaCatastrophicMaiming: Catastrophic Maiming: Complete destruction or mangling of a limb or organ. The character falls unconscious and permanently loses 1 point from a physical attribute and a related skill.
USR.TraumaDeathsDoor: Death's Door: The character collapses into a comatose state. They instantly lose 1D4 Blood Points from their pool right now.
USR.TraumaHeadScar: Facial disfigurement. Permanently lose -1 to Charisma. Gains a +1 bonus success whenever using Charisma for intimidation or interrogation tasks.
USR.TraumaHeadFracture: Fractured jaw, orbital bone, or severe concussion. Permanently lose -1 to Awareness.
USR.TraumaHeadNerve: Traumatic brain injury. Permanently lose -1 to Intelligence or Willpower (player's choice).
USR.TraumaHeadMaim: Destroyed sensory organ or crushed skull. Permanently lose -1 to Awareness and -1 to Intelligence.
USR.TraumaArmsScar: Jagged, deep scar along the limb. Purely narrative; no mechanical penalty.
USR.TraumaArmsFracture: Poorly set bone or shattered joint. Permanently lose -1 to one manual Skill tied directly to that arm (e.g., Melee, Ranged, Craftsmanship, Engineering, or Medicine).
USR.TraumaArmsNerve: Chronic tremors or loss of fine motor control. Permanently lose -1 to Initiative.
USR.TraumaArmsMaim: Amputated, crushed, or fully paralyzed arm. Permanently lose -1 to Initiative and suffer a permanent -2 success penalty to all manual skill checks attempting to utilize that arm.
USR.TraumaTorsoScar: Wide, prominent scar across the chest or back. Purely narrative; no mechanical penalty.
USR.TraumaTorsoFracture: Malformed rib cage or restrictive scar tissue limiting respiration. Permanently lose -1 to Mobility.
USR.TraumaTorsoNerve: Deep internal trauma or spinal nerve damage causing chronic pain. Permanently lose -1 to Willpower.
USR.TraumaTorsoMaim: Internal organ destruction or severe structural spinal deformation. Permanently lose -1 to Fortitude (dynamically shrinking maximum Blood Pool capacity by 2 points).
USR.TraumaLegsScar: Deep scar tissue along the thigh or calf. Purely narrative; no mechanical penalty.
USR.TraumaLegsFracture: Shattered knee or ankle resulting in a permanent, pronounced limp. Permanently lose -1 to Mobility.
USR.TraumaLegsNerve: Sciatic nerve damage or localized motor deficits. Permanently lose -1 to Initiative.
USR.TraumaLegsMaim: Severely crippled or entirely missing leg. Permanently lose -1 to Fortitude and -1 to Mobility. Top running speed capabilities are permanently halved.
